questions.stem: 碳稅（carbon tax）已經被許多國家採用，迫使企業為自己排放到空氣中的溫室氣體付出代價。
questions.answer: Carbon taxes have been adopted by many countries, forcing companies to pay for the greenhouse gases they release into the air.
accepted_answers: Carbon taxes have been introduced in many countries, forcing businesses to pay the price for the greenhouse gases that they release into the air.
A carbon tax has been adopted by many countries, making companies pay for the greenhouse gases they send into the air.

patterns: 句尾分詞片語表結果（, forcing …）

questions.stem: 讓企業為汙染付費，被許多經濟學家視為對抗氣候變遷最公平的方式之一。
questions.answer: Making companies pay for pollution is regarded by many economists as one of the fairest ways to fight climate change.
accepted_answers: Making businesses pay for their pollution is considered by many economists to be one of the fairest ways to fight climate change.
Making companies pay for the pollution they cause is seen by many economists as one of the fairest ways to deal with climate change.

1.explanation_zh: 「已經被許多國家採用」用現在完成式被動 have been adopted by many countries。「迫使企業…」是採用碳稅的結果，用句尾分詞 , forcing + 受詞 + to V（force 後面接 to V）。「自己排放到空氣中的溫室氣體」修飾語在前，英文用省略 that 的關係子句 the greenhouse gases (that) they release into the air 放在名詞後面。「付出代價」用 pay for …／pay the price for …。
evidence: 迫使企業為自己排放到空氣中的溫室氣體付出代價
1.strategy_zh: 「已經被…」→ have/has been + p.p.；「…，迫使／使得…」→ , forcing/making + O + (to) V。
hints: 切成四段：碳稅已經被許多國家採用／迫使企業／為自己排放到空氣中的溫室氣體／付出代價
標的詞彙：adopt（採用）、country（國家）、force（迫使）、company（企業）、pay for（為…付出代價）、greenhouse gas（溫室氣體）、release（排放）
句型框架：S + have been p.p. by …, forcing + O + to pay for + N + (that) + S + V

2.explanation_zh: 「讓企業為汙染付費」整個動作當主詞，用動名詞片語 Making companies pay for pollution（make 後面接原形 pay），動名詞主詞視為單數。「被…視為」用被動 is regarded as／is considered (to be)／is seen as，by many economists 可放在動詞後面。「…最公平的方式之一」用 one of the + 最高級 + 複數名詞 one of the fairest ways，「對抗」寫成不定詞 to fight／combat climate change 修飾 ways。
2.strategy_zh: 動作當主詞 → V-ing … + 單數動詞；「被視為」→ be regarded as／be considered (to be)。
hints: 切成四段：讓企業為汙染付費／被許多經濟學家視為／對抗氣候變遷／最公平的方式之一
標的詞彙：make（讓）、company（企業）、pay for（付費）、pollution（汙染）、regard（視為）、economist（經濟學家）、fair（公平的）、way（方式）、fight（對抗）、climate（氣候）
句型框架：V-ing … + is regarded by … as one of the + 最高級 + 複數名詞 + to V

references: Carbon taxes have been adopted by many countries, forcing companies to pay for the greenhouse gases they release into the air.
Carbon taxes have been introduced in many countries, forcing businesses to pay the price for the greenhouse gases that they release into the air.
A carbon tax has been adopted by many countries, making companies pay for the greenhouse gases they send into the air.

patterns.label_zh: 完成式被動（已經被…採用）
句尾分詞片語表結果（迫使…）
patterns.frame: S + V …, forcing + O + to V …

parts.zh: 碳稅（carbon tax）已經被許多國家採用
accepted: Carbon taxes have been adopted by many countries
Carbon taxes have been introduced in many countries
A carbon tax has been adopted by many countries
Carbon taxes have been put into effect in many countries

common_errors.wrong: Carbon taxes have adopted by many countries
common_errors.right: Carbon taxes have been adopted by many countries
common_errors.explanation_zh: 碳稅是「被」採用，現在完成式被動是 have been + p.p.；少了 been 意思變成碳稅去採用別的東西。

common_errors.wrong: Carbon tax has been adopted by many countries
common_errors.right: A carbon tax has been adopted by many countries
common_errors.explanation_zh: tax 是可數名詞，單數要加 a，或用複數 taxes。

accepted: forcing companies to
forcing businesses to
making companies

common_errors.explanation_zh: force + 受詞 + to V；make 才接原形動詞。
前面已有完整句子，表示結果要用句尾分詞 forcing；用 forced 會變成第二個主要動詞卻沒有連接詞。

parts.zh: 為自己排放到空氣中的溫室氣體
accepted: the greenhouse gases they release into the air
the greenhouse gases that they release into the air
the greenhouse gases they send into the air
the greenhouse gases they give off

common_errors.wrong: the greenhouse gas they release into the air
common_errors.right: the greenhouse gases they release into the air
common_errors.explanation_zh: 溫室氣體有很多種，泛指時用複數 gases。

common_errors.wrong: the greenhouse gases they release them into the air
common_errors.right: the greenhouse gases they release into the air
common_errors.explanation_zh: 關係子句的受詞已經由（省略的）that 代替，不可再寫 them。

accepted: pay for
pay the price for

common_errors.explanation_zh: 片語是 pay the price for …（為…付出代價），介系詞用 for。
「付出代價」不是 pay cost；用 pay for … 或 pay the price for …。

traps.literal_error: Carbon taxes are adopted by many countries already
traps.explanation_zh: 「已經被…」表示到現在已完成的狀態，用現在完成式被動 have been adopted；只用現在式被動看不出「已經」。

traps.literal_error: forcing companies to pay cost for …
traps.explanation_zh: 「付出代價」是抽象說法，英文用 pay for …（為…付錢、負責）或 pay the price for …；pay cost 是逐字直譯。

bonus.text: Now adopted by many countries, carbon taxes make companies pay for every ton of greenhouse gas they pump into the air.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用分詞構句 Now adopted by … 開頭，主句直接講影響；every ton of …、pump into the air 讓句子更具體。這是加分寫法。

1.restructuring_zh: 「迫使企業為…付出代價」承接前面整件事，英文用句尾分詞 forcing companies to pay for …；「為自己排放到空氣中的溫室氣體」修飾語在前，英文改成 the greenhouse gases (that) they release into the air。

references: Making companies pay for pollution is regarded by many economists as one of the fairest ways to fight climate change.
Making businesses pay for their pollution is considered by many economists to be one of the fairest ways to fight climate change.
Making companies pay for the pollution they cause is seen by many economists as one of the fairest ways to deal with climate change.

patterns.label_zh: 動名詞片語當主詞（讓企業為汙染付費）

accepted: Making companies pay for pollution
Making businesses pay for their pollution
Making companies pay for the pollution they cause
To make companies pay for pollution

common_errors.wrong: Make companies pay for pollution is
common_errors.right: Making companies pay for pollution is
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「讓企業為汙染付費」是一件事當主詞，要用動名詞 Making …（或 To make …），原形 Make 不能當主詞。

common_errors.wrong: Making companies to pay for pollution
common_errors.explanation_zh: 使役動詞 make + 受詞 + 原形動詞 pay，不加 to。

accepted: is regarded by many economists as
is considered by many economists to be
is seen by many economists as
is viewed by many economists as

common_errors.wrong: is regarded by many economists to
common_errors.right: is regarded by many economists as
common_errors.explanation_zh: regard A as B，被動是 A is regarded as B；consider 才可以接 to be。

common_errors.wrong: are regarded by many economists as
common_errors.right: is regarded by many economists as
common_errors.explanation_zh: 動名詞片語當主詞視為單數，動詞用 is。

accepted: to fight climate change
to deal with climate change
to combat climate change
to tackle climate change

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「對抗」在這裡是動作，要有動詞：to fight／combat／tackle climate change；只寫 against 少了動詞。
「氣候變遷」是名詞片語 climate change。

accepted: one of the fairest ways
one of the fairest methods
one of the fairest approaches

common_errors.explanation_zh: one of the + 最高級 + 複數名詞：way 要加 s。

common_errors.wrong: one of the most fairest ways
common_errors.explanation_zh: fair 的最高級是 fairest，不能再加 most。

traps.literal_error: Let companies pay for pollution is regarded …
traps.explanation_zh: 中文直接用動作「讓企業付費」當主詞，英文要變成動名詞片語 Making companies pay …（或 To make …），不能用原形動詞 Let／Make 開頭當主詞。

traps.literal_error: … one of the fairest ways against climate change
traps.explanation_zh: 「對抗」要寫成動詞：to fight／combat／tackle climate change；只用介系詞 against 少了動作。

bonus.text: Many economists regard putting a price on pollution as one of the fairest weapons against climate change.
bonus.explanation_zh: regard + V-ing + as …：把動名詞片語 putting a price on pollution（為汙染定價）改當受詞，句子更緊湊；weapons against … 是比喻用法。這是加分寫法。

warnings: annotations.rubric.items.1.patterns[0]: gp-perfect-passive 通常對應句構 PERF（目前 code=PASS）

1.translation: Carbon taxes have been adopted by many countries, forcing companies to pay for the greenhouse gases they release into the air.
1.explanation_zh: 「已經被許多國家採用」用現在完成被動 have been adopted by；碳稅是各國各自的稅，用複數；「迫使企業…」是結果，用分詞 forcing companies to；「為自己排放…的溫室氣體付出代價」用 pay for＋省略關係代名詞的子句 they release into the air（也可 emit）。

2.translation: Making companies pay for their pollution is regarded by many economists as one of the fairest ways to fight climate change.
2.explanation_zh: 「讓企業為汙染付費」當主詞，用動名詞 Making companies pay for…；「被…視為」用 is regarded as（也可 seen as／considered）；「最公平的方式之一」用 one of the fairest ways，ways 複數；「對抗氣候變遷」用 to fight climate change。

1.translation: A carbon tax has been adopted by many countries, forcing companies to pay for the greenhouse gases they release into the air.
1.explanation_zh: 「已經被許多國家採用」用現在完成被動 has been adopted by；「迫使企業……」用現在分詞 forcing ... to pay for 表結果；「排放到空氣中的溫室氣體」用省略 that 的關係子句 they release into the air。

2.translation: Making companies pay for pollution is regarded by many economists as one of the fairest ways to fight climate change.
2.explanation_zh: 「讓企業為汙染付費」用動名詞片語 Making companies pay for pollution 當主詞；「被……視為」用 is regarded ... as；「最公平的方式之一」用 one of the fairest ways；「對抗氣候變遷」用 fight climate change。
